title: Mysterious Natural Phenomena in China
synopsis: Learn about three strange natural phenomena found in different places in China.

fullText.simplified:
中国神奇的自然现象

    中国有960多万平方公里，地大物博，从南到北，由东到西，每个地方都有自己独特的自然景观，也存在很多神奇的自然现象。今天就给大家介绍三个有趣的自然现象。
    第一个是“泾渭分明”。
    中国有个成语叫“泾渭分明”。这里边的“泾”是“泾河”，“渭”是“渭河”。渭河是黄河的最大支流，水很浑；泾河又是渭河的最大支流，水很清。但这两条河交汇的地方，一半是浑浊带泥沙的水，一半是清澈见底的水，两河交汇处，完全不会互相渗透，而是各自流淌。泾河水清，渭河水浑，泾河的水流入渭河，清浊不混。所以后来人们就用“泾渭分明”来比喻界限清楚或者是非分明。
    第二个是“太阳三升”。
    中国云南丽江的西部有一个叫做“黎明”的村子。冬至前后的半个月，村民可以在同一天看到三次日出日落。出现这种情况和它特殊的地理位置有关，从黎明村的北端向东望去，可以看见三座大山，这三座山一座比一座高，所以太阳升起来以后，分别被三座大山挡住，这样就形成了太阳三升三落的景象。
    第三个是“怪坡现象”。
    中国东北沈阳市闫家村附近有个“怪坡”，长80米，宽15米。表面看上去西高东低，但是如果你骑着自行车从西坡顶向下骑，不用脚踩车的话，车子一点儿都不会走；但在东坡的下边向上骑，就算你不用脚踩车，车子也会自己往上滑行。
    怎么样，上边提到的自然现象是不是很神奇呢？你的国家有什么神奇的自然现象呢？
fullText.traditional:
中國神奇的自然現象

    中國有960多萬平方公里，地大物博，從南到北，由東到西，每個地方都有自己獨特的自然景觀，也存在很多神奇的自然現象。今天就給大家介紹三個有趣的自然現象。
    第一個是“涇渭分明”。
    中國有個成語叫“涇渭分明”。這裡邊的“涇”是“涇河”，“渭”是“渭河”。渭河是黃河的最大支流，水很渾；涇河又是渭河的最大支流，水很清。但這兩條河交匯的地方，一半是渾濁帶泥沙的水，一半是清澈見底的水，兩河交匯處，完全不會互相滲透，而是各自流淌。涇河水清，渭河水渾，涇河的水流入渭河，清濁不混。所以後來人們就用“涇渭分明”來比喻界限清楚或者是非分明。
    第二個是“太陽三升”。
    中國雲南麗江的西部有一個叫做“黎明”的村子。冬至前後的半個月，村民可以在同一天看到三次日出日落。出現這種情況和它特殊的地理位置有關，從黎明村的北端向東望去，可以看見三座大山，這三座山一座比一座高，所以太陽升起來以後，分別被三座大山擋住，這樣就形成了太陽三升三落的景象。
    第三個是“怪坡現象”。
    中國東北瀋陽市閆家村附近有個“怪坡”，長80米，寬15米。表面看上去西高東低，但是如果你騎著自行車從西坡頂向下騎，不用腳踩車的話，車子一點兒都不會走；但在東坡的下邊向上騎，就算你不用腳踩車，車子也會自己往上滑行。
    怎麼樣，上邊提到的自然現象是不是很神奇呢？你的國家有什麼神奇的自然現象呢？

sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó yǒu 4 duō wàn píng fāng gōng lǐ dì dà wù bó

sentences.simplified: 从南到北，由东到西，每个地方都有自己独特的自然景观，也存在很多神奇的自然现象。
sentences.traditional: 從南到北，由東到西，每個地方都有自己獨特的自然景觀，也存在很多神奇的自然現象。
sentences.pinyin: cóng nán dào běi yóu dōng dào xī měi ge dì fang dōu yǒu zì jǐ dú tè de zì rán jǐng guān yě cún zài hěn duō shén qí de zì rán xiàn xiàng
sentences.english: Covering more than 9.6 million square kilometers, China is a vast country with abundant resources.

sentences.simplified: 今天就给大家介绍三个有趣的自然现象。
sentences.traditional: 今天就給大家介紹三個有趣的自然現象。
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān jiù gěi dà jiā jiè shào sān ge yǒu qù de zì rán xiàn xiàng
sentences.english: From south to north and east to west, each place has its own unique natural landscape, and there are many mysterious natural phenomena.
Today, I will introduce three interesting natural phenomena to everyone.

sentences.simplified: 第一个是“泾渭分明”。
sentences.traditional: 第一個是“涇渭分明”。
sentences.pinyin: dì yī ge shì jīng wèi fēn míng

sentences.english: The first one is “Jing and Wei separate clearly”.

sentences.simplified: 中国有个成语叫“泾渭分明”。
sentences.traditional: 中國有個成語叫“涇渭分明”。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó yǒu ge chéng yǔ jiào jīng wèi fēn míng

sentences.simplified: 这里边的“泾”是“泾河”，“渭”是“渭河”。
sentences.traditional: 這裡邊的“涇”是“涇河”，“渭”是“渭河”。
sentences.pinyin: zhè lǐ bian de jīng shì jīng hé wèi shì wèi hé
sentences.english: There is a Chinese idiom that says “Jing and Wei separate clearly”.

sentences.simplified: 渭河是黄河的最大支流，水很浑；
sentences.traditional: 渭河是黃河的最大支流，水很渾；
sentences.pinyin: wèi hé shì huáng hé de zuì dà zhī liú shuǐ hěn hún
sentences.english: Here, “Jing” is the “Jing River”, and “Wei” is the “Wei River”.

sentences.simplified: 泾河又是渭河的最大支流，水很清。
sentences.traditional: 涇河又是渭河的最大支流，水很清。
sentences.pinyin: jīng hé yòu shì wèi hé de zuì dà zhī liú shuǐ hěn qīng
sentences.english: The Wei River is the largest tributary of the Yellow River, and its water is very muddy.

sentences.simplified: 但这两条河交汇的地方，一半是浑浊带泥沙的水，一半是清澈见底的水，
sentences.traditional: 但這兩條河交匯的地方，一半是渾濁帶泥沙的水，一半是清澈見底的水，
sentences.pinyin: dàn zhè liǎng tiáo hé jiāo huì de dì fang yí bàn shì hún zhuó dài ní shā de shuǐ yí bàn shì qīng chè jiàn dǐ de shuǐ
sentences.english: The Jing River is the largest tributary of the Wei River, and its water is very clear.

sentences.simplified: 两河交汇处，完全不会互相渗透，而是各自流淌。
sentences.traditional: 兩河交匯處，完全不會互相滲透，而是各自流淌。
sentences.pinyin: liǎng hé jiāo huì chù wán quán bú huì hù xiāng shèn tòu ér shì gè zì liú tǎng
sentences.english: But where these two rivers meet, half of the water is muddy with silt, and half is clear enough to see the bottom.

sentences.simplified: 泾河水清，渭河水浑，
sentences.traditional: 涇河水清，渭河水渾，
sentences.pinyin: jīng hé shuǐ qīng wèi hé shuǐ hún
sentences.english: Where the two rivers meet, they do not permeate each other, but instead, flow separately.

sentences.simplified: 泾河的水流入渭河，清浊不混。
sentences.traditional: 涇河的水流入渭河，清濁不混。
sentences.pinyin: jīng hé de shuǐ liú rù wèi hé qīng zhuó bú hùn
sentences.english: The Jing River has clear water, and the Wei River has muddy water.

sentences.simplified: 所以后来人们就用“泾渭分明”来比喻界限清楚或者是非分明。
sentences.traditional: 所以後來人們就用“涇渭分明”來比喻界限清楚或者是非分明。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ hòu lái rén men jiù yòng jīng wèi fēn míng lái bǐ yù jiè xiàn qīng chu huò zhě shì fēi fēn míng
sentences.english: When water from the Jing River flows into the Wei River, the clear water and muddy water do not mix.
So, people later used “Jing and Wei separate clearly” as a metaphor for clear boundaries or a clear distinction between right and wrong.

sentences.simplified: 第二个是“太阳三升”。
sentences.traditional: 第二個是“太陽三升”。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr ge shì tài yáng sān shēng

sentences.english: The second one is “three sunrises”.

sentences.simplified: 中国云南丽江的西部有一个叫做“黎明”的村子。
sentences.traditional: 中國雲南麗江的西部有一個叫做“黎明”的村子。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó yún nán lì jiāng de xī bù yǒu yí ge jiào zuò lí míng de cūn zi

sentences.simplified: 冬至前后的半个月，村民可以在同一天看到三次日出日落。
sentences.traditional: 冬至前後的半個月，村民可以在同一天看到三次日出日落。
sentences.pinyin: dōng zhì qián hòu de bàn ge yuè cūn mín kě yǐ zài tóng yì tiān kàn dào sān cì rì chū rì luò
sentences.english: In the western part of Lijiang, Yunnan Province, China, there is a village called “Liming”.

sentences.simplified: 出现这种情况和它特殊的地理位置有关，
sentences.traditional: 出現這種情況和它特殊的地理位置有關，
sentences.pinyin: chū xiàn zhè zhǒng qíng kuàng hé tā tè shū de dì lǐ wèi zhi yǒu guān
sentences.english: In the half month before and after the winter solstice, villagers can see the sunrise and sunset three times on the same day.

sentences.simplified: 从黎明村的北端向东望去，可以看见三座大山，这三座山一座比一座高，
sentences.traditional: 從黎明村的北端向東望去，可以看見三座大山，這三座山一座比一座高，
sentences.pinyin: cóng lí míng cūn de běi duān xiàng dōng wàng qù kě yǐ kàn jiàn sān zuò dà shān zhè sān zuò shān yí zuò bǐ yí zuò gāo
sentences.english: This situation has to do with its special geographical location.

sentences.simplified: 所以太阳升起来以后，分别被三座大山挡住，
sentences.traditional: 所以太陽升起來以後，分別被三座大山擋住，
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tài yáng shēng qǐ lái yǐ hòu fēn bié bèi sān zuò dà shān dǎng zhù
sentences.english: Looking east from the northern end of Liming village, you see three big mountains, each higher than the next.

sentences.simplified: 这样就形成了太阳三升三落的景象。
sentences.traditional: 這樣就形成了太陽三升三落的景象。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng jiù xíng chéng le tài yáng sān shēng sān luò de jǐng xiàng
sentences.english: So after the sun rises, it is blocked in turn by each of the three big mountains.
This produces the sight of the sun rising and setting three times.

sentences.simplified: 第三个是“怪坡现象”。
sentences.traditional: 第三個是“怪坡現象”。
sentences.pinyin: dì sān ge shì guài pō xiàn xiàng

sentences.english: The third is “the strange slope phenomenon”.

sentences.simplified: 中国东北沈阳市闫家村附近有个“怪坡”，长80米，宽15米。
sentences.traditional: 中國東北瀋陽市閆家村附近有個“怪坡”，長80米，寬15米。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó dōng běi shěn yáng shì yán jiā cūn fù jìn yǒu ge guài pō cháng 2 mǐ kuān 2 mǐ

sentences.simplified: 表面看上去西高东低，
sentences.traditional: 表面看上去西高東低，
sentences.pinyin: biǎo miàn kàn shàng qù xī gāo dōng dī
sentences.english: Near Yanjia village in Shenyang City, northeast China, there is a “strange slope”, 80 meters long and 15 meters wide.

sentences.simplified: 但是如果你骑着自行车从西坡顶向下骑，不用脚踩车的话，车子一点儿都不会走；
sentences.traditional: 但是如果你騎著自行車從西坡頂向下騎，不用腳踩車的話，車子一點兒都不會走；
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì rú guǒ nǐ qí zhe zì xíng chē cóng xī pō dǐng xiàng xià qí bú yòng jiǎo cǎi chē de huà chē zi yì diǎn'r dōu bú huì zǒu
sentences.english: The surface looks higher in the west and lower in the east.

sentences.simplified: 但在东坡的下边向上骑，就算你不用脚踩车，车子也会自己往上滑行。
sentences.traditional: 但在東坡的下邊向上騎，就算你不用腳踩車，車子也會自己往上滑行。
sentences.pinyin: dàn zài dōng pō de xià bian xiàng shàng qí jiù suàn nǐ bú yòng jiǎo cǎi chē chē zi yě huì zì jǐ wǎng shàng huá xíng
sentences.english: However, if you try riding a bike down the slope from the top in the west, and you don’t pedal, the bike won’t move one bit.
But if you try riding up the slope from the lower east side, even if you don’t pedal, the bike will slide upwards by itself.

sentences.traditional: 怎麼樣，上邊提到的自然現象是不是很神奇呢？你的國家有什麼神奇的自然現象呢？

sentence_translations: Mysterious Natural Phenomena in China
Covering more than 9.6 million square kilometers, China is a vast country with abundant resources.
From south to north and east to west, each place has its own unique natural landscape, and there are many mysterious natural phenomena.
Today, I will introduce three interesting natural phenomena to everyone.
The first one is “Jing and Wei separate clearly”.
There is a Chinese idiom that says “Jing and Wei separate clearly”.
Here, “Jing” is the “Jing River”, and “Wei” is the “Wei River”.
The Wei River is the largest tributary of the Yellow River, and its water is very muddy.
The Jing River is the largest tributary of the Wei River, and its water is very clear.
But where these two rivers meet, half of the water is muddy with silt, and half is clear enough to see the bottom.
Where the two rivers meet, they do not permeate each other, but instead, flow separately.
The Jing River has clear water, and the Wei River has muddy water.
When water from the Jing River flows into the Wei River, the clear water and muddy water do not mix.
So, people later used “Jing and Wei separate clearly” as a metaphor for clear boundaries or a clear distinction between right and wrong.
The second one is “three sunrises”.
In the western part of Lijiang, Yunnan Province, China, there is a village called “Liming”.
In the half month before and after the winter solstice, villagers can see the sunrise and sunset three times on the same day.
This situation has to do with its special geographical location.
Looking east from the northern end of Liming village, you see three big mountains, each higher than the next.
So after the sun rises, it is blocked in turn by each of the three big mountains.
This produces the sight of the sun rising and setting three times.
The third is “the strange slope phenomenon”.
Near Yanjia village in Shenyang City, northeast China, there is a “strange slope”, 80 meters long and 15 meters wide.
The surface looks higher in the west and lower in the east.
However, if you try riding a bike down the slope from the top in the west, and you don’t pedal, the bike won’t move one bit.
But if you try riding up the slope from the lower east side, even if you don’t pedal, the bike will slide upwards by itself.
Well, aren’t these natural phenomena really mysterious? Are there any mysterious natural phenomena in your country?
